purpose: Supplement structural speaker resolution with scene/quest-level diegetic attribution without altering the reproducible lower-level resolver output.

basis: Both scenes use alias 0 from CLWDialogueAmalgam.
Alias 0 is a speaker-horn reference rather than an NPC form.
Crystalline Heart stages 50–60 describe the remote speaker-horn voice leading the player to the unusual Gilded/Amalgam in the Sickness Ward.
Multiple response strings are independently duplicated in Amalgam-conditioned dialogue.
Scene actor alias 3 resolves directly to the Amalgam encounter base used by the Crystalline Heart stage-70 encounter.

caveat: resolution-stats.json remains unchanged because it reports the stricter lower-level NPC-form resolver. These supplemental attributions rely on scene ownership, quest aliases, and diegetic quest context.
